clues.title: Coverage: Vibes
text: Coverage in Greenland was taken with many different vehicles. Architecture and landscape look very similar all over Greenland but it's hard to put it in words but it's pretty recognizable that's why I included it in this map.

text: Most locations with coverage will have their own odd and unique Street View vehicles, ranging from a red tractor to a snowmobile with a large box at the front.

clues.title: Architecture: Architecture
text: Greenlandic architecture mainly consists of small, colourful, simple looking wooden houses, which even in cities are typically placed quite sparsely.
The major cities have some larger buildings, which normally look fairly minimalistic.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
